spec_match.rationale: Every edit is getPathData() → mutate → setPathData(), followed by a read back. Structural edits splice plain object literals. 'Absolutize' replaces a relative path with getPathData({normalize:true}).

interactive.rationale: Pointer-draggable and keyboard-movable handles, add/remove segment, absolutize and reset. Live d and segment table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the card's editor round trip.

edge_cases.rationale: Stale-handle guard (rebuilds when the segment index has vanished), points clamped to the viewBox, and a no-op message when only the moveto remains.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless: by default all three methods are undefined (each page shows its labelled unsupported state). With --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, getPathData/setPathData are live but getPathSegmentAtLength is still undefined. Both viewports, every control exercised, console/network clean, 0px overflow. With the flag, arrow keys and a pointer drag moved segment 1's C control point (read back matches), and add/remove/absolutize all ran.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the read-back match for each pointer and keyboard move, and the insert result.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; anchors are blue and control points rose, with dashed guides.

accessibility.rationale: Handles are tabindex=0 role=button with names that include segment, value indices, coordinates and arrow-key hints. Moves are announced in the status line.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: touch-action:none on handles, 14px hit radius, and buttons wrap. 0px overflow at 360.

openQuestions.title: Enlarge handle hit areas on touch
openQuestions.detail: The hit circle is 14 SVG units, which scales below 44 CSS px on a 360px-wide canvas. Consider scaling the hit radius by the current CTM on coarse pointers.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible SVG interactive editor drag handles keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give drag handles a focusable button role and a name that mentions arrow keys, use setPointerCapture with touch-action:none on the handle only, and make arrow-key movement go through the same clamped move helper.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each SVG handle <g> is tabindex=0 role=button with an aria-label naming its segment and value pair and the arrow-key interaction. Pointer capture and touch-action:none are on the handles only. Arrow keys (Shift for fine steps) call the same clamped movePoint() as pointer drags.

summary: A real node editor built only on getPathData/setPathData round trips, operable by pointer and keyboard.
